question: Can source-view responsibility evidence select between the current strong unary and one fixed surface-safe propagated field without target RGB, mask, metric, or scene identity?

historical_failure_audit.old_method: hash256 logistic unary versus fixed f2/g4 K201 release-compatible diffusion
historical_failure_audit.finding: The three-fold mechanics were strict, but both candidates belonged to an obsolete hash256/K201 interface and cannot gate the current K4/K16 compiler or surface-safe graph.
historical_failure_audit.reuse: Reuse only deterministic folds, heldout clearing, balanced log-loss, weighted AUC, and unary tie-break. Never reuse hash256 features, K201 topology, or old full-fit predictions.

candidate_actions.name: unary
candidate_actions.definition: Current task compiler's canonical unary_prior probability using only the two training folds' source prompt evidence.

candidate_actions.name: surface_safe_propagated
candidate_actions.definition: The same fold-specific unary followed only by the fixed typed surface-safe canonical support graph; no hash256 relation, no K201 kernel, and no connected selection.

fixed_surface_safe_graph.covisibility: admit only a responsibility sidecar cryptographically bound to raw MPR geometry; soft weight 0.25; otherwise omit

cross_validation.population: capability-valid rows with nonzero untampered source signed responsibility evidence
cross_validation.label: raw positive responsibility mass greater than raw negative responsibility mass; exact ties excluded
cross_validation.reference_weight: raw positive plus raw negative raster-adjoint responsibility mass
cross_validation.leakage_rule: For fold f, set positive_weight, negative_weight, raw_positive_mass, and raw_negative_mass to exact zero on every capability-valid row assigned to f before constructing direct observation, solver seeds, prototypes, unary anchors, unary, or propagation.
cross_validation.heldout_prediction: Read each action's probability only on nonzero heldout source-evidence rows; never overwrite heldout predictions with direct anchors.
cross_validation.selection: lexicographically minimize rounded log-loss, maximize rounded AUC, then choose unary on a tie

development.role: validate that the immutable source-only gate chooses the previously observed target-safe action
development.promotion_gate: Both development selections must match the expected action; otherwise stop before heldout target scoring and report source-observation gate mismatch.

heldout.opening_rule: For every heldout scene, freeze and reload the complete three-fold OOF gate receipt first; then generate and seal both full-fit action predictions before any target mask or target metric is opened.
heldout.rule_after_target_metrics: The selected action and all method constants are immutable; no branching or parameter changes.

predictions.spin9:room: Gate likely selects propagated if surface relations reconstruct heldout source responsibilities better; otherwise unary.
predictions.nvos:horns_center: Gate likely selects unary because sparse strong anchors make propagation unnecessary.
predictions.nvos:horns_left: Gate likely selects unary because the old reference-only CV already rejected propagation despite using weaker candidates.

promotion.rule: Promote the gate only if the development selection gate passes and heldout selected-action macro IoU is not below always-unary macro IoU; report per-scene deltas without scene-specific overrides.
promotion.stop: Any leakage, insufficient fold population, action mismatch on development, missing receipt, or heldout macro regression stops promotion.

execution.thermal_check: stage boundaries and at most every 180 seconds
execution.thermal_abort: two consecutive samples at or above 88C
